description: This file defines a Java interface called DelinquencyEffectivePauseHelper, which contains method signatures related to calculating effective delinquency actions and paused days for loans within the delinquency domain of the Fineract project.

classes.name: DelinquencyEffectivePauseHelper
classes.description: An interface defining methods for calculating delinquency-related date ranges and lists within the loan delinquency processing domain.

methods.name: calculateEffectiveDelinquencyList
methods.description: Calculates a list of LoanDelinquencyActionData based on saved delinquency actions.

methods.name: getPausedDaysBeforeDate
methods.description: Returns the number of paused days before a given date based on effective delinquency data.

methods.name: getPausedDaysWithinRange
methods.description: Returns the number of paused days within a specified date range based on effective delinquency data.
